answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 458 Country: India Title: I belong to the hanafi mashlaq. My fathers sister has been married at reshinagar which are actually ahmadiyas. Is it permissible for me to go there or not. can I eat there or not.what is my obligation towards them? Question: I belong to the hanafi mashlaq. My fathers sister has been married at reshinagar which are actually ahmadiyas. Is it permissible for me to go there or not. can I eat there or not.what is my obligation towards them? Answer ID: 458 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707=477/H) The Qadyanis or Mirzaees, who call themselves Ahmadi, are murtad (apostate) and out of the folk of Islam. It is prohibited to have terms with them and to eat or drink with them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
